text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
This is just like... a movie adaptation!

Hearing the news that Narita Brian was entering the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
Biko Pegasus was thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The theatrical Carrotman movies sometimes do crossovers with other heroes!
Like Umaren 5 or Purify!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I never expected Brian-san from a different track to barge in.
Friend or foe...? I don't know, I just don't know...
choice_data_list: Yeah, what on earth could they be thinking...
Yeah, I wonder what they're thinking...

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume world was thrown into complete chaos by this baffling challenge.
Experts and fans alike joined in a resounding chorus of "Why?!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Could this be meant as a substitute for training?
Or did she just get desperate after losing her last race?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Would Brian really get desperate?
Maybe she genuinely believes
she can win them all...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now that it's come to this,
let's use the Carrot Balloon!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Deploying the recon machine!
Vroom vroom vroooom!

Despite calling it a machine, Biko Pegasus dashed off
on her own two feet. I immediately gave chase.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Phew... *pant*... phew...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There she is...!
Brian's really going at it, full throttle...
Just how many laps has she done...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Just the speed alone is incredible enough... With this, even the sprints should be no problem...
choice_data_list: Yeah, but... you're not at your best.
Yeah, but... you're not at your best.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How about this?!

You nod. When Narita Brian is in top form,
she doesn't just run fast—she tears down the track with a ferocious roar.

That snarl is gone now. Rather than a hungry wolf,
she gave the impression of a snow leopard.
"What I'm sensing isn't so much a lack in the run itself, but rather..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see... No matter how fast you are,
if you're not in top form...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I... might not be able to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I can't just take down someone who's weakened!
If they're struggling, the first thing to do is lend a helping hand!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, somehow I'm gonna help Brian-san get back in peak condition!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san!
Is there anything I can do to help!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can do, I'll do it!
So please!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah... Hey!

She didn't even give an answer.
Narita Brian simply continued
her training in silence, alone.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer, sis...
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A hero is supposed to save everyone...
But even though Brian-san is probably in trouble,
she won't ask for help...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
That's true...
Things have gotten pretty complicated, haven't they...?

Meeting up with an older girl who happened to come by,
the three of them think it over. At this rate,
they won't be able to enjoy a proper race.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Narita Brian has her own thoughts on this.
However...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"I can't say it out loud.
Or rather, I don't want to..."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Even if they haven't sent out a distress signal, it feels like there's something they want done."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss, what's that, what's that!?
What does Brian-san want us to do!?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wouldn't go that far...
I'm no race expert, after all...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have any idea?
What Narita Brian came to the sprints
looking for?
"...I don't know. But when I was watching training earlier, there was something that clearly caught my attention."
choice_data_list: She seemed different from the Brian I knew before.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What's different? Well, that is...

What was different.
It wasn't her running itself, but rather—
—Her eyes.

There was no killer instinct in her eyes. It seemed she lacked
the "hunger" to seek something beyond her running.
In other words—

It's not a physical issue, but a mental one.
If "that" is what Narita Brian is seeking...
choice_data_list: Let me take a moment to think up a plan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you need some time, right!
Then... got it!
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it true!? Did you figure out
how we can save Brian-san?

I couldn't say it was absolute.
Yet it was something very close to certainty.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! As expected of Captain
Onion! So, how do we save them?

To rescue Narita Brian from her predicament.
There is only one order to give Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh... Beat them?
choice_data_list: Yeah, crush them with everything you've got. They're tough opponents.
Yeah, go all out and crush them. Your opponent is strong

text_block_list.text:
A wounded beast is still a beast. Even at our specialized
sprint distance, she won't be an easy opponent to beat.
I deliberately used harsh words, telling her to crush Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No way... Telling me to crush Brian-san
when she's not in top form...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Captain Onion! Is that what a hero
does!? I'll...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, fighting is salvation...?
Isn't that completely backwards...?"

It's not backwards.
Most likely, the reason Narita Brian jumped into sprints is...
—Shock therapy. Ever since her injury, she just hasn't been able to fire herself up like she used to...

Hence the challenge of venturing into the unexpected.
She must be looking to reignite her fighting spirit through the intense thrill of sprint racing.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you came here
instead of the Osaka Hai...
A thick bedrock closing off the heart. There are few Umamusume even among sprinters who can shatter it. If so—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I will shatter it...
The wall around Brian-san's heart..."
choice_data_list: Yeah, become a demon! There's no room for kindness.
Yeah, be ruthless! No room for kindness here.

text_block_list.text:
Unless I run well enough to threaten Narita Brian,
I won't be able to reignite
her fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see, for Brian-san's sake...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying... I should become him.
The "Black Carrot Man."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Once upon a time, Carrotman was consumed by anger just once, becoming Dark Carrotman.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And with terrifying strength unbecoming of a hero,
she defeated General Nikubacker
of the Unhealthy Empire.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: General Meatbacker was the kind of guy you could only get through to with brute force. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman cast aside justice, fought back
the way his opponent wanted, and won."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... So that's what
I'm supposed to do...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the incarnation of rage to beat down Brian-san.
Is that really your only "salvation"?
choice_data_list: Yeah, you can only achieve it through sheer intensity!
Yeah, this can only be achieved through sheer intensity!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got it!
Then I'll—cast justice aside!
I'll become the pitch-black arrow that defeats Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!!!

Facing the impending interspecies showdown,
Biko Pegasus's expression changed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *wheeze*... Grrrgh!
Her usual innocence vanished, replaced by a fierce instinct peering through. To the point of feeling truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I will win! Against Brian-san!
This is... a battle to see who survives!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Trainer. To think you were able to help
a completely lost Biko look forward again.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I was a bit worried about what comes next, but...
I think we'll be just fine now.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Actually, filming in Hollywood is finally about to start. So—"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "I won't be able to see Biko-chan anymore. But please don't tell her yet. I want her to focus on her races for now."

Still in shock, she gave a slight nod.
Narita Brian was certainly not an opponent
one could face with a divided mind.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
That's why, you see. I want to burn it into my memory.
Biko-chan's race of a lifetime. And—

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: With that heroic figure in my heart, I want to do my best in America too!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Go, Biko-chaaaan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: OH!! HAAAAAAAH!!!

The moment for the great decisive battle,
and a small parting, steadily draws near.
